task_text: I have a video call starting in 5 minutes. My desk area needs to look presentable and I should be able to see and hear clearly. The bedroom light is off.

plans.R1:
[0-5 min]
- R1 [LOCAL] PickupLightObject: Pick up the small plant from the table. (r1_s1)
- R1 [LOCAL] PlaceObject: Place the plant on the desk to add a decorative touch. (r1_s2)
- R1 [LOCAL] PickupLightObject: Pick up the remote control from the table. (r1_s3)
- R1 [LOCAL] UseObject: Turn on the TV to check the lighting and sound. (r1_s4)

[5-10 min]
- R1 [LOCAL] AdjustObject: Adjust the lamp to ensure good lighting for the video call. (r1_s5)
- R1 [LOCAL] UseObject: Turn off the TV to avoid background noise. (r1_s6)
- R1 [LOCAL] PickupLightObject: Pick up any small clutter from the desk area. (r1_s7)
- R1 [LOCAL] PlaceObject: Place the clutter in the box to tidy up the area. (r1_s8)
plans.R2:
[0-5 min]
- R2 [LOCAL] PickupLightObject: Turn on the lamp on the side table to improve lighting for the video call. (r2_s1)

[5-10 min]
- R2 [LOCAL] PickupLightObject: Adjust the position of the laptop on the couch to ensure the camera is at eye level and the microphone is unobstructed. (r2_s2)
plans.R3:
[0-5 min]
- R3 [LOCAL] Turn on the desk lamp to improve lighting. (r3_s1)
- R3 [LOCAL] Arrange the notebook and pen neatly on the desk. (r3_s2)
- R3 [LOCAL] Ensure the phone is placed face down to avoid distractions. (r3_s3)
- R3 [LOCAL] Adjust the plant to be upright and tidy. (r3_s4)

[5-10 min]
- R3 [LOCAL] Check that the laptop is open and positioned correctly for the video call. (r3_s5)
- R3 [LOCAL] Ensure the monitors are clean and free of dust. (r3_s6)
- R3 [LOCAL] Verify that the chair is positioned correctly for comfortable seating. (r3_s7)
plans.R4:
[0-5 min]
- R4 [LOCAL] Turn on the bedroom light to improve visibility. (r4_s1)
- R4 [LOCAL] Tidy up the desk by organizing scattered items and ensuring the laptop is centered. (r4_s2)
- R4 [LOCAL] Adjust the chair to face the desk properly. (r4_s3)

[5-10 min]
- R4 [LOCAL] Move the trash can slightly out of view from the camera. (r4_s4)
- R4 [LOCAL] Ensure the window blinds are adjusted to reduce glare on the screen. (r4_s5)
- R4 [LOCAL] Check the laptop's camera and microphone settings for clear video and audio. (r4_s6)
